prompt: If it takes one person 7 days to build a wall, how long does it takes 7 persons to build 7 walls?
response:
If one person takes 7 days to build one wall, then the amount of work done by one person in one day is building 1/7 of a wall. 

When you have 7 persons working together, they can build 7 times as much as one person in one day. So, 7 persons can build 7/7 = 1 wall in one day.

Therefore, 7 persons can build 7 walls in 7 days, because they can build 1 wall per day together.
